title: Orbital
synopsis: A lyrical meditation on Earth and humanity through the eyes of six astronauts and cosmonauts over sixteen sunrises and sunsets aboard the International Space Station.

title: Prophet Song
synopsis: A chilling portrait of a mother fighting to protect her family as Ireland descends into totalitarianism, told in relentless, breathless paragraphs.

title: The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida
synopsis: A mordant, afterlife mystery following a dead war photographer who has seven moons to solve his murder and lead his loved ones to photographs that will rock Sri Lanka.

title: The Promise
synopsis: Charting the decline of a white South African family over four decades through four funerals, defined by an unkept promise made to their Black domestic servant.

title: Shuggie Bain
synopsis: Set in working-class 1980s Glasgow, an intimate and heart-wrenching story of a young boy's fierce love for his proud, alcoholic mother.

title: Girl, Woman, Other
synopsis: A vibrant polyphonic tapestry tracing the intertwined lives and struggles of twelve primarily Black British women across decades and social classes.

title: The Testaments
synopsis: Picking up fifteen years after Offred stepped into the unknown, the explosive sequel to The Handmaid's Tale reveals Gilead's inner workings through three distinct testimonies.

title: Lincoln in the Bardo
synopsis: An extraordinary polyphonic theatrical novel set in a Georgetown cemetery over a single night in 1862, where the spirit of Abraham Lincoln's recently deceased son Willie lingers.

title: Wolf Hall
synopsis: A masterclass in historical imagination tracing the rise of Thomas Cromwell in the perilous, mercurial court of King Henry VIII.

title: The Underground Railroad
synopsis: A devastating, inventive reimagining in which the antebellum Underground Railroad is not a metaphor, but a secret subterranean network of tracks, conductors, and steam engines.

title: The Nickel Boys
synopsis: Based on the real atrocities at the Dozier School in Florida, following two Black boys sentenced to a hellish juvenile reformatory during the Jim Crow era.

title: Demon Copperhead
synopsis: A contemporary Appalachian reimagining of David Copperfield, charting an orphaned boy's survival through poverty, foster care, addiction, and athletic glory.

title: Trust
synopsis: An elegant puzzle-box novel that interrogates wealth, deception, and power across four competing versions of a 1920s Wall Street financier and his brilliant wife.

title: Night Watch
synopsis: A richly rendered Civil War saga set in the aftermath of the conflict, following a traumatized mother and daughter finding sanctuary inside a West Virginia lunatic asylum.

title: The Netanyahus
synopsis: A biting campus comedy and intellectual tour de force chronicling the arrival of Benzion Netanyahu and his disruptive young family at an upstate New York college in 1959.

title: The Night Watchman
synopsis: Based on the life of Erdrich's grandfather, a night watchman at a jewel-bearing plant who led the Chippewa resistance against federal termination legislation in 1953.

title: The Overstory
synopsis: A sweeping epic that intertwines the lives of nine distinct strangers summoned by trees to combat the destruction of North America's virgin forests.

title: Sing, Unburied, Sing
synopsis: A haunting road trip through contemporary Mississippi as a fractured family travels to pick up a father released from Parchman Farm penitentiary, shadowed by ancestral ghosts.

title: Blackouts
synopsis: An inventive dialogue and erasure collage between a young narrator and an aging man dying in a desert hospice, excavating suppressed twentieth-century queer history.

title: The Rabbit Hutch
synopsis: Over a scorching July week in a decaying Indiana post-industrial town, the trapped residents of an affordable apartment complex careen toward a climactic act of violence.

title: Hell of a Book
synopsis: A wildly imaginative, satirical journey of a Black author on a cross-country publicity tour who is accompanied by an invisible child and hallucinations.

title: Interior Chinatown
synopsis: Written in the format of a television screenplay, satirizing Hollywood stereotypes through Willis Wu, a background actor trapped playing 'Generic Asian Man'.

title: Brotherless Night
synopsis: Set during the onset of the Sri Lankan civil war, recounting a young Tamil woman aspiring to be a doctor who gets swept into moral crisis and underground reporting.

title: The Book of Form and Emptiness
synopsis: After the tragic loss of his father, fourteen-year-old Benny starts hearing the voices of inanimate objects, finding sanctuary in a public library where books speak with him.

title: Piranesi
synopsis: Piranesi lives in the House, an infinite labyrinth of halls lined with thousands of statues and surging ocean tides, until a sinister second visitor disturbs his solitary peace.

title: Hamnet
synopsis: A tender reimagining of Shakespeare's domestic life in 1590s Warwickshire, centering on Agnes Hathaway and the devastating loss of their eleven-year-old son to the plague.

title: Kairos
synopsis: A claustrophobic, doomed romance between an older married writer and a young student in 1980s East Berlin, mirrored by the crumbling collapse of East Germany.

title: Time Shelter
synopsis: A 'clinic for the past' cures Alzheimer's by recreating past decades in meticulous detail, but soon entire European nations hold referendums on which decade to live in.

title: Tomb of Sand
synopsis: An 80-year-old Indian matriarch sinks into deep depression after her husband's death, then gains an unexpected new lease on life and insists on traveling to Pakistan to confront the past.

title: The Vegetarian
synopsis: A modern South Korean woman's decision to stop eating meat provokes vicious family and societal outrage, escalating into a surreal metamorphosis.

title: A Memory Called Empire
synopsis: Ambassador Mahit Dzmare arrives in the heart of the multi-system Teixcalaanli Empire to discover her predecessor was murdered, threatening her independent mining station.

title: The Fifth Season
synopsis: On the supercontinent of the Stillness, a civilization shaped by periodic extinction-level seismic seasons is brought to its knees when a vast rift is torn through the world.

title: Ducks, Newburyport
synopsis: Composed almost entirely of a single, breath-taking thousand-page sentence, an Ohio mother and baker ruminates on pie crusts, family, mass shootings, and environmental dread.

title: Solenoid
synopsis: A failed poet teaching in Communist Bucharest inhabits a house built atop a gigantic underground electrical coil (solenoid) that produces anti-gravity and dimensional tears.

title: The Sellout
synopsis: A razor-sharp satire about a young Black man raised by a single-parent sociologist in an agrarian enclave of Los Angeles, who attempts to reinstitute segregation to save his community.

title: A Brief History of Seven Killings
synopsis: A sweeping, polyphonic epic revolving around the attempted assassination of Bob Marley in Kingston, Jamaica, spanning decades of drug wars, CIA plots, and geopolitical turmoil.

title: The Narrow Road to the Deep North
synopsis: A despairing and intensely moving account of an Australian surgeon held prisoner of war by the Japanese on the Thai-Burma Death Railway, sustained by memories of an illicit affair.

title: The Luminaries
synopsis: Set during the 1860s New Zealand gold rush, a dazzlingly constructed murder mystery mapped meticulously against the movements of the zodiac and heavenly spheres.

title: Bring Up the Bodies
synopsis: The ferocious sequel to Wolf Hall following Thomas Cromwell as he orchestrates the downfall and trial of Queen Anne Boleyn to clear the way for Jane Seymour.

title: The Sense of an Ending
synopsis: An aging retired arts administrator confronts the unreliability of his youthful memories when an unexpected bequest reopens a devastating tragedy from four decades prior.

title: The White Tiger
synopsis: A darkly comic, breathless confession written as letters to the Chinese Premier by Balram Halwai, charting his ruthless rise from village servant to successful Bangalore entrepreneur.

title: The Gathering
synopsis: Following the suicide of her beloved brother Liam in England, Veronica Hegarty summons her sprawling Irish family to Dublin while unearthing a dark childhood trauma.

title: The Inheritance of Loss
synopsis: Set in a decaying northeastern Himalayan mansion during a violent Gorkha insurgency, interweaving the bitter solitude of a retired judge with his cook's son struggling as an undocumented immigrant in New York.

title: Life of Pi
synopsis: Surviving a catastrophic shipwreck in the Pacific Ocean, sixteen-year-old Indian boy Pi Patel shares a tiny lifeboat for 227 days with a 450-pound Bengal tiger named Richard Parker.

title: The Blind Assassin
synopsis: An octogenarian Canadian matriarch unravels the mysterious suicide of her sister Laura in 1945 through an intricately nested sci-fi pulp novel within a novel.

title: The God of Small Things
synopsis: Set in 1969 Kerala, seven-year-old fraternal twins Rahel and Estha navigate the rigid boundaries of caste, love laws, and forbidden passion that shatter their family.

title: The English Patient
synopsis: In an abandoned Italian villa at the end of World War II, a young nurse tends to a burned, nameless amnesiac pilot whose fragmented memories reveal tragic desert romance and espionage.

title: The Remains of the Day
synopsis: Stevens, an aging English butler at Darlington Hall, embarks on a motoring trip across the countryside while reflecting on a lifetime of unswerving devotion to a disgraced master and unacknowledged love.

title: Midnight's Children
synopsis: Born at the stroke of midnight as India achieves independence, Saleem Sinai discovers that all 1,001 children born during that hour possess telepathic powers mirroring the nation's tumultuous fate.

title: Less
synopsis: Arthur Less, a struggling novelist on the cusp of fifty, accepts every obscure literary invitation across the globe to avoid attending his former lover's wedding.

title: The Sympathizer
synopsis: A gripping espionage thriller and confession of a half-French, half-Vietnamese communist sleeper agent embedded within the South Vietnamese army fleeing to Los Angeles after the fall of Saigon.

title: All the Light We Cannot See
synopsis: The stunningly interwoven paths of a blind French girl hiding with a precious museum diamond in Saint-Malo and a gifted German orphan whose radio expertise enlists him into the Nazi war machine.

title: The Goldfinch
synopsis: Surviving a terrorist bombing at the Metropolitan Museum that kills his mother, thirteen-year-old Theo Decker clings to a tiny Dutch Golden Age masterpiece that pulls him into the criminal underworld.

title: A Visit from the Goon Squad
synopsis: A kaleidoscopic novel in thirteen interconnected stories spanning forty years of the music industry, fame, aging, and digital culture (including a celebrated chapter told entirely in PowerPoint).

title: Tinkers
synopsis: Lying on his deathbed in New England, an elderly clock repairman drifts through fevered, poetic hallucinations of his father's life as an epileptic tinker traveling through wilderness on a mule cart.

title: The Brief Wondrous Life of Oscar Wao
synopsis: Following an overweight Dominican sci-fi nerd in New Jersey dreaming of love, haunted by the fukú—an ancient generational curse that has plagued his family from the brutal Trujillo dictatorship.

title: The Road
synopsis: A nameless father and his young son walk alone through burned, ash-covered post-apocalyptic America toward the southern coast, sustaining love and humanity amid cannibalism and extinction.

title: Gilead
synopsis: In 1956 Iowa, seventy-six-year-old Congregationalist pastor John Ames pens a testament and spiritual autobiography for his young son, exploring faith, grace, and reconciliation.

title: Middlesex
synopsis: The sweeping three-generation epic of the Stephanides family, fleeing the burning of Smyrna in 1922 to Detroit, carrying a mutated gene that culminates in Cal's intersex identity.

title: The Amazing Adventures of Kavalier & Clay
synopsis: In 1939 New York, teenage escape-artist refugee Josef Kavalier teams up with his Brooklyn cousin Sammy Clay to invent the comic superhero The Escapist, capturing the golden age of American comics.

title: The Shipping News
synopsis: Devastated by his cruel wife's infidelity and death, third-rate journalist Quoyle retreats with his two young daughters and aunt to his ancestral Newfoundland coast to rebuild his soul.

title: Beloved
synopsis: In post-Civil War Ohio, formerly enslaved Sethe is haunted by the vengeful ghost of the unnamed infant daughter she killed eighteen years earlier to spare her from the horrors of slavery.

title: Trust Exercise
synopsis: At a competitive performing arts high school in the 1980s, the passionate romance of two drama students is upended fourteen years later by a startling narrative pivot on truth and manipulation.

title: The Friend
synopsis: When a woman unexpectedly loses her lifelong friend and literary mentor to suicide, she becomes the reluctant caretaker of his traumatized Great Dane, Apollo.

title: The Good Lord Bird
synopsis: A riotous, tall-tale recounting of radical abolitionist John Brown's crusade as witnessed by Henry Shackleford, an enslaved boy who survives by passing as a girl.

title: Salvage the Bones
synopsis: Over twelve days leading up to Hurricane Katrina, pregnant fourteen-year-old Esch and her motherless brothers brace for the storm in the impoverished Mississippi bayou town of Bois Sauvage.

title: The Round House
synopsis: When his mother survives a brutal attack on the Ojibwe reservation in North Dakota, thirteen-year-old Joe Coutts embarks on an agonizing quest for justice amid a jurisdictional quagmire.

title: An American Marriage
synopsis: Newlywed Black professionals in Atlanta have their lives shattered when Roy is wrongfully sentenced to twelve years in prison for a crime he didn't commit.

title: Home Fire
synopsis: A devastating contemporary retelling of Sophocles' Antigone following three British Muslim siblings whose loyalties are torn when the youngest joins ISIS.

title: The Power
synopsis: Teenage girls across the world develop the biological power to emit deadly electric jolts from their fingertips, radically inverting the global patriarchy.

title: A Girl Is a Half-formed Thing
synopsis: Written in a fractured, rhythmic interior language of extraordinary immediacy, tracing an Irish girl's complex bond with her brother who survived childhood brain cancer.

title: Half of a Yellow Sun
synopsis: A landmark epic exploring the Biafran war for independence in 1960s Nigeria through the lives of twin sisters, a university professor, and a houseboy.

title: At Night All Blood Is Black
synopsis: In the trenches of WWI, Senegalese Tirailleur Alfa Ndiaye descends into chilling madness and ritualistic vengeance after the agonizing death of his childhood friend.

title: The Discomfort of Evening
synopsis: On a strict Dutch Reformed dairy farm, ten-year-old Jas navigates a family collapsing into dark, surreal grief after her older brother dies in an ice-skating accident.

title: Celestial Bodies
synopsis: In the Omani village of al-Awafi, tracing the lives of three sisters witnessing Oman's transition from a traditional, slave-owning society to oil-rich modernity.

title: Flights
synopsis: A brilliant constellation novel interweaving modern airport transit reflections with 17th-century anatomical history, Chopin's heart journey, and the human impulse to move.

title: Network Effect
synopsis: The first full-length novel in the Murderbot Diaries series, where the security android Murderbot must rescue its human companions from a mysterious alien hazard.

title: Ancillary Justice
synopsis: On a remote, icy planet, Breq—once the Justice of Toren, a colossal starship AI controlling thousands of human corpse soldiers—seeks vengeance for her destruction.

title: Milkman
synopsis: In an unnamed Northern Irish city during the Troubles, an 18-year-old girl is relentlessly pursued by a menacing paramilitary commander known as 'the milkman'.

title: The Finkler Question
synopsis: A biting, mournful comedy exploring friendship, aging, antisemitism, and Jewish identity through two old school friends and their teacher.

title: The Sea
synopsis: Following the death of his wife, art historian Max Morden returns to the seaside Irish town of his childhood summers, recalling an intoxicating aristocratic family and sudden tragedy.

title: The Line of Beauty
synopsis: In affluent 1980s London, a young gay aesthete moves in with a Tory politician's family, navigating cocaine, privilege, politics, and the looming shadow of the AIDS crisis.

title: Vernon God Little
synopsis: In the wake of a horrific high school shooting in Martirio, Texas, fifteen-year-old Vernon Little is falsely blamed and hounded by hysterical media and sensationalist justice.

title: True History of the Kelly Gang
synopsis: The semi-fictional diary of legendary Australian outlaw and bushranger Ned Kelly, written in a breathless, unpunctuated vernacular for his unborn daughter.

title: Disgrace
synopsis: After an affair with a student costs him his Cape Town professorship, middle-aged David Lurie retreats to his daughter's remote farm, where a brutal attack shatters their fragile peace.

title: Amsterdam
synopsis: At the funeral of a mutual former lover, a composer and a newspaper editor enter into a euthanasia pact that deteriorates into mutual moral corruption and revenge.

title: Last Orders
synopsis: Four working-class London men gather at a Bermondsey pub to fulfill their friend Jack's dying wish: carrying his ashes in a cardboard urn to scatter off the pier at Margate.

title: The Ghost Road
synopsis: The haunting conclusion to the Regeneration Trilogy, contrasting army psychiatrist W.H.R. Rivers' fevered memories of Melanesian headhunters with the final, fatal days of WWI in France.

title: How Late It Was, How Late
synopsis: Waking up blind in a police cell after a drunken weekend brawl, 38-year-old Glaswegian ex-con Sammy Samuels navigates bureaucracy and disability in relentless Glaswegian dialect.

title: Paddy Clarke Ha Ha Ha
synopsis: Told through the vibrant, sensory voice of ten-year-old Paddy Clarke growing up in 1968 Barrytown, Dublin, as his parents' marriage painfully dissolves.

title: Sacred Hunger
synopsis: Joint winner with The English Patient: Set in 1752, charting the fateful voyage of an 18th-century slave ship Liverpool Merchant and the utopian commune founded by survivors of a mutiny in Florida.

title: The Famished Road
synopsis: Narrated by Azaro, an abiku or spirit child in a Nigerian city who repeatedly refuses death to stay with his impoverished, fiercely loving parents amid political upheaval.

title: Possession
synopsis: Two young academics unearth secret draft letters between two prominent 19th-century poets, triggering an obsessive parallel journey across the English coast and France.

title: Oscar and Lucinda
synopsis: A misfitting Anglican clergyman and an Australian glassworks heiress, bonded by compulsive gambling, wager their fortunes to transport a prefabricated glass church across the New South Wales outback.

title: Moon Tiger
synopsis: Dying in a hospital bed, seventy-six-year-old former war correspondent Claudia Hampton composes a 'history of the world' that mirrors her own kaleidoscopic memories of wartime Cairo and lost love.

title: The Old Devils
synopsis: A group of retired Welsh friends whose comfortable routine of boozy pub lunches is upended by the flamboyant return of a former companion and his stylish wife.

title: The Bone People
synopsis: Set along the wild South Island coast, weaving Māori mythology, poetry, and tragedy through three outcasts who form an unlikely, volatile surrogate family.

title: Hotel du Lac
synopsis: Romance novelist Edith Hope is banished to an out-of-season luxury hotel on Lake Geneva by well-meaning friends following an embarrassing social scandal.

title: Life & Times of Michael K
synopsis: During a devastating civil war in South Africa, a simple hare-lipped gardener embarks on an arduous journey to return his dying mother to her rural birthplace.

title: Schindler's Ark
synopsis: The astonishing true story of German industrialist and Nazi party member Oskar Schindler, who gambled his fortune to protect over 1,200 Jews from extermination.

title: Rites of Passage
synopsis: Recorded in the journal of aristocratic passenger Edmund Talbot aboard an ancient converted warship sailing to Australia during the Napoleonic Wars, charting the tragic humiliation of a reverend.

title: Offshore
synopsis: Drawing on her own experiences living on a battered Thames barge, chronicling an eccentric community of houseboat dwellers berthed along Cheyne Walk in Chelsea.

title: The Sea, The Sea
synopsis: Retired London theater director Charles Arrowby buys an isolated coastal house to live as a hermit, but his retreat becomes a tempestuous den of vanity and obsession when he encounters his childhood sweetheart.

title: Staying On
synopsis: A bittersweet coda to the Raj Quartet following Colonel Tusker Smalley and his wife Lucy, the last British couple residing in an Indian hill station three decades after Independence.

title: Saville
synopsis: The detailed coming-of-age chronicle of Colin Saville, a miner's gifted son in rural Yorkshire, striving through education to escape his family's claustrophobic coal mining destiny.

title: Heat and Dust
synopsis: In 1970s India, a young Englishwoman retraces the 1920s steps of her great-aunt Olivia, whose scandalous elopement with an Indian Nawab had shocked British society.

title: The Conservationist
synopsis: Joint winner with Holiday: A wealthy white industrialist treats his 400-acre farm as a weekend playground until the unburied corpse of a murdered Black man surfaces after a flood.

title: Holiday
synopsis: Joint winner with The Conservationist: Edwin Fisher, a middle-class lecturer grieving the death of his infant son and marital separation, spends a solitary week at a seaside resort in Lincolnshire.

title: The Siege of Krishnapur
synopsis: Inspired by the 1857 Indian Mutiny, British colonial administrators and eccentrics besieged in a Residency watch their lofty Victorian ideals of progress crumble under dysentery and cannon fire.

title: G.
synopsis: An audacious avant-garde reimagining of the Don Juan myth set across Europe on the brink of World War I, interrogating sexual liberation, historical materialism, and class rebellion.

title: In a Free State
synopsis: A symphonic tripartite work centered on two white expatriates undertaking an ominous drive through an unnamed Central African nation spiraling into violent post-colonial coup.

title: The Elected Member
synopsis: The first novel by a woman to win the Booker Prize: Norman Zweck, a gifted prodigy turned amphetamine-addicted barrister, succumbs to hallucinations, forcing his Orthodox Jewish family to confront generational guilt.

title: Troubles
synopsis: Awarded the 'Lost Man Booker Prize' in 2010: In 1919 Ireland, shell-shocked Major Brendan Archer arrives at the crumbling Majestic Hotel in County Wexford as the Irish War of Independence erupts.

title: Something to Answer For
synopsis: The very first Booker Prize winner: In 1956 Port Said during the Suez Crisis, an Englishman arrives to investigate his friend's mysterious death, sinking into concussion, paranoia, and moral disorientation.

title: Flesh
synopsis: A searing and intimate examination of modern physical and emotional vulnerability, masculinity, and human connection across European cities.

title: The End of Everything
synopsis: A breathtaking metaphysical and speculative masterpiece exploring memory, decay, and the edges of reality, crowning Harrison's legendary six-decade career.

title: James
synopsis: A brilliant, harrowing, and fiercely witty reimagining of Adventures of Huckleberry Finn told from the perspective of the enslaved Jim, who reveals a clandestine intellectual life.

title: Angel Down
synopsis: A haunting and atmospheric American tragedy charting grief, rust-belt decay, and sudden spiritual revelation in a forgotten heartland town.

title: Heart Lamp
synopsis: Translated by Deepa Bhasthi: The first short story collection to win the International Booker, chronicling the intimate, resilient lives of Muslim women in southern India.

title: Taiwan Travelogue
synopsis: Translated by Lin King: Set in 1938 Japanese-occupied Taiwan, following a Japanese novelist and her local Taiwanese interpreter bonding through shared meals, linguistic secrets, and unspoken desire.

title: The Age of Innocence
synopsis: In 1870s high-society New York, Newland Archer must choose between a socially advantageous marriage and his scandalous passion for Countess Ellen Olenska.

title: The Magnificent Ambersons
synopsis: The decline of a proud, wealthy aristocratic Indianapolis family eclipsed by the rise of the automobile and industrial wealth.

title: The Bridge of San Luis Rey
synopsis: When an ancient Incan rope bridge collapses in 18th-century Peru sending five travelers to their deaths, a Franciscan friar investigates whether it was divine providence or chance.

title: The Good Earth
synopsis: The epic dramatization of rural Chinese peasant Wang Lung and his stoic wife O-Lan, charting their struggle from famine to immense land wealth.

title: The Grapes of Wrath
synopsis: Driven from their Oklahoma farm by drought and economic ruin, the Joad family joins thousands of Dust Bowl refugees journeying along Route 66 to California.

title: All the King's Men
synopsis: Narrated by political reporter Jack Burden, tracing the meteoric rise and moral corruption of populist Southern governor Willie Stark.

title: Tales of the South Pacific
synopsis: A collection of nineteen interconnected stories capturing the lives, boredom, romance, and courage of US sailors, Marines, and islanders during WWII.

title: The Caine Mutiny
synopsis: Aboard an obsolete US Navy minesweeper in the Pacific, junior officers relieve their paranoid, neurotic commander Captain Queeg of duty during a typhoon.

title: The Old Man and the Sea
synopsis: An aging Cuban fisherman named Santiago endures an agonizing, heroic battle in the Gulf Stream against a giant marlin and marauding sharks.

title: A Fable
synopsis: A complex allegorical WWI novel transposing the Passion of Christ into a mutiny on the Western Front led by a corporal and twelve followers.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
synopsis: In 1930s Maycomb, Alabama, young Scout Finch watches her lawyer father Atticus defend Tom Robinson, a Black man falsely accused of raping a white woman.

title: The Reivers
synopsis: In 1905, eleven-year-old Lucius Priest and two companions steal his grandfather's car to take a four-day joyride to a Memphis brothel and horse race.

title: The Fixer
synopsis: In Tsarist Russia, Yakov Bok, a poor Jewish handyman, is unjustly imprisoned and tortured under false accusations of ritual murder.

title: The Confessions of Nat Turner
synopsis: A fictional first-person account of Nat Turner as he sits in a Virginia jail cell awaiting execution for leading the bloody 1831 slave rebellion.

title: House Made of Dawn
synopsis: Young Abel returns to his New Mexico pueblo traumatized after World War II, caught between traditional Kiowa identity and the alienating urban world.

title: Angle of Repose
synopsis: A wheelchair-bound historian reconstructs the turbulent frontier marriage of his pioneer grandparents across California and Idaho mining camps.

title: The Killer Angels
synopsis: The four fateful days of the Battle of Gettysburg in July 1863, told through the perspectives of Confederate and Union commanders.

title: Humboldt's Gift
synopsis: Playwright Charlie Citrine reflects on his friendship with the brilliant, manic poet Von Humboldt Fleisher, receiving an unexpected posthumous legacy.

title: A Confederacy of Dunces
synopsis: The misadventures of Ignatius J. Reilly, an eccentric, flatulent, medievalist philosopher forced to take odd jobs across 1960s New Orleans.

title: Rabbit Is Rich
synopsis: Harry 'Rabbit' Angstrom is middle-aged, prosperous, and running a Toyota dealership during the 1979 energy crisis, until ghosts of the past resurface.

title: The Color Purple
synopsis: Through letters written to God and her sister, impoverished Southern Black girl Celie survives decades of abuse and discovers love and empowerment.

title: Lonesome Dove
synopsis: Two aging Texas Rangers lead an epic cattle drive from the dusty Rio Grande to the untamed wilderness of Montana.

title: Rabbit at Rest
synopsis: In the final installment of the Rabbit tetralogy, Harry Angstrom confronts declining health, heart failure, and familial unraveling in late 1980s Florida.

title: American Pastoral
synopsis: Seymour 'Swede' Levov, a Newark athletic idol and prosperous glove manufacturer, watches his American dream shattered when his daughter bombs a local post office in anti-war protest.

title: The Hours
synopsis: Three generations of women affected by Virginia Woolf's Mrs. Dalloway: Woolf herself in 1923, a 1949 post-war housewife, and a 1990s editor in Manhattan.

title: Interpreter of Maladies
synopsis: Nine luminous stories exploring emotional dislocation, marital secrets, and cultural navigation among Indians and Indian Americans.

title: Empire Falls
synopsis: Miles Roby manages the Empire Grill in a declining Maine mill town dominated by a ruthless matriarch, balancing family dreams and sudden violence.

title: The Known World
synopsis: In antebellum Virginia, Henry Townsend, a Black farmer and former slave, becomes a slaveholder under the guidance of his white mentor, unravelling moral complexities.

title: Olive Kitteridge
synopsis: Thirteen interconnected stories centered on blunt, compassionate retired schoolteacher Olive Kitteridge in coastal Crosby, Maine.

title: The Orphan Master's Son
synopsis: An orphan raised in North Korea navigates shifting roles as tunnel soldier, kidnapper, radio spy, and imposter across a surreal totalitarian state.

title: Invisible Man
synopsis: A nameless Black narrator addresses the reader from an underground coal cellar illuminated by 1,369 lightbulbs, recounting his invisibility in racist America.

title: The Adventures of Augie March
synopsis: 'I am an American, Chicago born...' Augie March grows up in poverty during the Depression, dodging domestic traps and wandering the world on his own terms.

title: The Man with the Golden Arm
synopsis: Inaugural National Book Award winner: Frankie Machine, a card dealer and morphine addict on Chicago's gritty West Side, dreams of becoming a jazz drummer.

title: From Here to Eternity
synopsis: The raw, brutal realities of life in a peacetime US Army infantry company stationed in Oahu in the months leading up to the attack on Pearl Harbor.

title: Goodbye, Columbus
synopsis: Roth's sensational debut: A working-class Newark boy falls in love with an affluent Radcliffe student in suburban New Jersey over one fateful summer.

title: The Moviegoer
synopsis: During Mardi Gras in New Orleans, 29-year-old stockbroker Binx Bolling undertakes an existential 'search' to awaken from the malaise of modern everyday life.

title: Herzog
synopsis: Moses Herzog, a cuckolded and spiraling academic, composes unmailed, brilliant letters to the living and dead, from ex-wives to Nietzsche and God.

title: them
synopsis: Three decades in the turbulent, impoverished lives of a working-class Detroit mother and her two children, culminating in the 1967 Detroit riots.

title: Gravity's Rainbow
synopsis: Set in Europe at the end of WWII, tracing American lieutenant Tyrone Slothrop and the elusive V-2 rocket in a colossal, paranoid labyrinth of science, sex, and conspiracy.

title: J R
synopsis: Told almost exclusively through dialogue with no attribution: An eleven-year-old Long Island schoolboy builds a multi-million-dollar paper business empire from a school payphone.

title: Going After Cacciato
synopsis: When a soldier deserts his unit in Vietnam to walk 8,600 miles to Paris, his squad tracks him across real and imagined landscapes of war and peace.

title: White Noise
synopsis: Jack Gladney, chairman of Hitler studies at a Midwest college, confronts suburban consumerism, media saturation, and mortality during an 'Airborne Toxic Event'.

title: All the Pretty Horses
synopsis: In 1949 Texas, sixteen-year-old John Grady Cole rides horseback into Mexico with a friend, discovering romantic cowboy dreams crushed by brutality.

title: Waiting
synopsis: Every summer for eighteen years, army doctor Lin Kong returns to his village to divorce his arranged wife, trapped by bureaucratic and emotional inertia.

title: The Corrections
synopsis: The Lambert family—an aging Midwestern couple and their three troubled adult children—try to assemble for one last Christmas at home as their father descends into Parkinson's.

title: The Echo Maker
synopsis: After surviving a near-fatal truck rollover on a misty Nebraska river road during crane migration, Mark Schluter awakens with Capgras delusion, believing his sister is an imposter.

title: Tree of Smoke
synopsis: A colossal, psychedelic Vietnam War epic centering on young CIA operative Skip Sands, his legendary spymaster uncle, and two soldier brothers.

title: Let the Great World Spin
synopsis: On a misty August morning in 1974, Philippe Petit walks a tightrope between the Twin Towers, connecting disparate New Yorkers down below in grief and redemption.

title: Redeployment
synopsis: Twelve searing stories detailing the brutal psychological costs of the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan on soldiers, chaplains, and returning veterans.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
synopsis: The mythical rise and fall of the isolated jungle town of Macondo through seven generations of the Buendía family, interweaving war, levitation, insomnia, and solitude.

title: Satantango
synopsis: In a decaying communal agricultural estate in rural Hungary drenched in endless autumn rain, desperate inhabitants fall under the spell of a charismatic, presumed-dead messiah.

title: Blindness
synopsis: A sudden, unexplained epidemic of contagious 'white blindness' sweeps through an unnamed city, disintegrating societal order inside a squalid quarantine asylum.

synopsis: 'Mother died today. Or maybe yesterday; I can't be sure.' Meursault, a detached French Algerian clerk, commits a senseless murder on a sun-drenched Algiers beach.

title: Creation Lake
synopsis: A cunning American undercover agent infiltrates a radical environmental collective in rural southwestern France.

title: Held
synopsis: A lyrical, multi-generational tapestry tracing the reverberations of love, trauma, and battle from 1917 France to the near future.

title: The Safekeep
synopsis: In 1961 rural Netherlands, an austere woman living in her late mother’s house is destabilized by an unwanted guest and buried wartime memories.

title: Stone Yard Devotional
synopsis: A deeply burnt-out woman leaves her marriage to live alongside cloistered nuns in regional New South Wales.

title: The Bee Sting
synopsis: A magnificent, hilarious, and devastating family saga of a prosperous Irish clan unraveling in the wake of the financial crash.

title: Study for Obedience
synopsis: A young woman relocates to an unnamed northern European hamlet to keep house for her newly wealthy brother, finding herself blamed for local misfortunes.

synopsis: Connected stories about Jamaican-American brothers striving to forge identities, jobs, and belonging in Miami after Hurricane Andrew.

title: This Other Eden
synopsis: Inspired by the true 1912 racial expulsion of mixed-race islanders off Maine, exploring humanity, art, and the violence of eugenics.

title: Western Lane
synopsis: Eleven-year-old Gopi pours her grief and quiet intensity into squash training after her mother’s death in the British Gujarati community.

title: Treacle Walker
synopsis: A fusion of Cheshire folklore and physics in which a young boy with a lazy eye exchanges goods with a roaming rag-and-bone man.

title: Small Things Like These
synopsis: In December 1985 Ireland, a compassionate coal merchant encounters the grim reality of a convent Magdalene laundry and makes a life-altering choice.

title: Glory

title: The Fortune Men

title: Great Circle
synopsis: Dual storylines track a daring female aviator who vanished crossing the poles in 1950 and the young actress portraying her decades later.

title: The Shadow King

title: Burnt Sugar

title: This Mournable Body
synopsis: The gripping conclusion to Dangarembga’s trilogy finds Tambudzai fighting against poverty and despair in post-independence Harare.

title: The New Wilderness
synopsis: To save her daughter from toxic city air, a mother joins a study group surviving in the last untamed wilderness reserve.

title: Quichotte

synopsis: An eleven-year-old enslaved boy on a Barbados sugar estate becomes assistant to an eccentric naturalist and flies away in a dirigible.

title: The Mars Room
synopsis: A former lap dancer and mother begins two life sentences at a women’s correctional facility in California’s Central Valley.

title: Everything Under
synopsis: An eerie reimagining of the Oedipus myth set along the murky English canals where a lexicographer seeks her estranged mother.

title: The Long Take
synopsis: A cinematic noir narrative in verse charting a traumatized veteran’s journey through post-war American cities in the late 1940s.

title: Flashlight
synopsis: A haunting psychological exploration of childhood secrets, truth, and familial bonds across generations.

title: The Loneliness of Sonia and Sunny
synopsis: A sweeping international exploration of two intertwined lives adrift between Mumbai and the West in an era of rapid transition.

title: Audition

title: The Rest of Our Lives
synopsis: A deeply human portrait of long friendships and married intimacy facing the quiet crises of later life.

title: The Land in Winter
synopsis: During the harsh freeze of 1963 in the English West Country, a country doctor and his expectant wife confront community isolation.

title: The Things We Never Say
synopsis: Three generations of Maine women reckon with ancestral silence, late-life companionship, and the unspoken truths of small-town life.

title: John of John
synopsis: A visceral, tender novel of brothers navigating hardship, Catholic guilt, and survival along the post-industrial Clyde.

title: The Disappearers
synopsis: A polyphonic historical epic charting maroon communities and hidden resistance fighters in 18th-century Jamaica.

title: Black Bag
synopsis: An office worker discovers a bottomless void inside a boardroom cupboard, escalating into a razor-sharp satire of modern employment.

title: May We Feed the King
synopsis: Set in an 18th-century menagerie, an intimate fable examining companionship, creaturely suffering, and sovereign obsession.

title: Wednesday's Child
synopsis: A deeply moving story collection examining parental love, loss, and the resilience of human memory across continents.

title: Same Bed Different Dreams
synopsis: A dizzying, genre-colliding alternate history revolving around a secret Korean provisional government continuing into the digital era.

title: The Immortal King Rao

title: Palmares

title: There There
synopsis: Twelve Native Americans travel to the Big Oakland Powwow, bound by shared heritage, modern struggle, and impending tragedy.

title: The Great Believers
synopsis: A devastating dual-timeline epic linking the 1980s Chicago AIDS epidemic with a mother searching for her daughter in 2015 Paris.

title: Martyr!
synopsis: A newly sober Iranian-American poet travels to Brooklyn to interview a dying artist staging her final performance at a museum.

title: Ghostroots
synopsis: Twelve chilling, folklore-infused stories exploring hauntings, maternal inheritance, and metamorphosis in modern Lagos.

title: All Fours
synopsis: A semi-famous artist driving cross-country stops at a suburban motel minutes from home to initiate an intimate reinvention.

synopsis: A poignant meditation on friendship, literature, and the longing for home following Libyan political exiles across London.

title: Chain-Gang All-Stars
synopsis: Incarcerated gladiators battle in televised arena death matches for a shot at freedom in a privatized American prison industry.

title: The Tainted Cup

synopsis: Raised on a fanatical space station indoctrinated to avenge Earth’s annihilation, a young female soldier unravels the horrific lies of her command.

title: Nettle & Bone
synopsis: A quiet convent princess completes three impossible tasks to forge bone tools and set out with unlikely companions to slay a monstrous prince.

title: Babel, or the Necessity of Violence

synopsis: Ambassador Mahit Dzmare and Three Seagrass are dispatched to the war-torn imperial frontier to attempt communication with an incomprehensible alien enemy.

title: A Master of Djinn

title: The Obelisk Gate
synopsis: Essun finds shelter in an underground comm as the Fifth Season deepens, unlocking the terrifying celestial power of the ancient hovering obelisks.

title: All the Birds in the Sky
synopsis: Childhood friends—a witch chosen by nature and a rebellious tech inventor—reconnect as adults while climate collapse and magical cataclysm collide.

title: Uprooted
synopsis: A clumsy village girl is chosen by the brooding wizard known as the Dragon, learning instinctive folk magic to combat a malevolent, creeping Wood.

title: The Three-Body Problem
synopsis: During China’s Cultural Revolution, a secret military astrophysics project broadcasts signals that trigger a planned invasion by an alien trisolaran civilization.

title: Annihilation
synopsis: A female biologist and her team enter Area X, an overgrown coastal anomalous zone where previous expeditions vanished, fell to cancer, or turned upon each other.

title: Redshirts
synopsis: Lowly crew members on the starship Intrepid discover they are unwitting characters trapped inside an incomprehensible space-opera television narrative.
Three centuries in the future, humans inhabit terraformed asteroids and moons across the solar system, caught up in interplanetary mystery following an attack on Mercury.

title: Among Others
synopsis: A disabled fifteen-year-old Welsh girl survives an encounter with her dark-magic mother, seeking friendship and protection through sci-fi book clubs and quiet fairies.

title: Blackout / All Clear
synopsis: Oxford time-travel historians journey to the London Blitz in 1940 and become stranded as timeline disruptions threaten both their survival and the war itself.

title: The Windup Girl

title: The City & The City
synopsis: Inspector Tyador Borlú investigates the murder of a foreign student found dead in Besźel, an Eastern European metropolis cross-hatched with an overlapping rival city.

title: The Yiddish Policemen's Union
synopsis: In an alternate Sitka, Alaska, serving as a temporary haven for Jewish refugees, homicide detective Meyer Landsman investigates a murdered chess prodigy.

title: Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell
synopsis: In Regency England, two magicians resurrect the lost English magic, helping Britain defeat Napoleon before feuding over the dangerous Raven King.

title: Paladin of Souls
synopsis: Widowed Dowager Royina Ista embarks on a holy pilgrimage to escape her smothering court, finding herself called as a divine instrument against demonic forces.

title: American Gods

title: Parable of the Talents

title: The Diamond Age: Or, A Young Lady’s Illustrated Primer
synopsis: In a future governed by distributed cultural phyles and molecular compilers, an illicit interactive primer falls into the hands of a street child named Nell.

title: Green Mars
synopsis: Following the failed First Revolution, the surviving First Hundred organize an underground planetary resistance while biosystems and greenery take root on Mars.

title: A Fire Upon the Deep
synopsis: A malevolent superintelligence awakens in the galactic Transcend, while two human children crash-land among an alien pack-mind civilization.

title: Doomsday Book
synopsis: Oxford medievalist Kivrin Engle travels to 14th-century England, discovering upon arrival that an error has stranded her during the terrifying outbreak of the Black Death.

title: Hyperion
synopsis: Seven diverse pilgrims voyage to the Time Tombs on Hyperion to meet the legendary Shrike, each sharing their intimate story along the way.

title: Ender's Game
synopsis: Six-year-old tactical prodigy Ender Wiggin is sent to an orbital battle school where children play zero-gravity war games to prepare for an alien invasion.

title: Speaker for the Dead
synopsis: Three millennia after the destruction of the Buggers, Ender Wiggin travels to Lusitania to speak the truth of a murdered scientist and understand the alien Pequeninos.

title: Neuromancer
synopsis: Burned-out computer hacker Case is given one last shot at jacking into cyberspace to penetrate the security of an unthinkably powerful corporate artificial intelligence.

title: Startide Rising
synopsis: The exploration vessel Streaker, crewed by genetically uplifted dolphins and humans, discovers a legendary alien fleet and is hunted by fanatic extraterrestrial armadas.

title: The Fountains of Paradise
synopsis: Visionary engineer Vannevar Morgan undertakes the supreme engineering challenge of building a space elevator anchored to a sacred mountain peak on the tropical island of Taprobane.

title: Dreamsnake
synopsis: In a post-nuclear landscape, Snake wanders from settlement to settlement healing the sick using the tranquilizing venom of genetically engineered serpents.

title: Gateway
synopsis: Desperate prospectors journey to an asteroid full of abandoned alien spacecraft, blindly launching them into hyperspace hoping for wealth or meeting horrific deaths.

title: The Forever War
synopsis: Conscripted to fight an interstellar war against the Taurans, physics student William Mandella experiences subjective months in combat while centuries elapse on Earth.

title: The Dispossessed

title: Rendezvous with Rama

title: The Gods Themselves

title: Ringworld

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
synopsis: A human envoy arrives on the icy world of Gethen, whose people choose no fixed gender, forging a bond of love and survival with an exiled native minister across an ice sheet.

title: Flowers for Algernon
synopsis: Progress reports document the journey of Charlie Gordon, whose intelligence is exponentially boosted by surgery before he faces the inevitable regression of his mind.

title: Dune
synopsis: Set on the hostile desert world of Arrakis, young Paul Atreides becomes the messianic leader of the Fremen in an epic battle over the spice melange.

title: The Man in the High Castle
synopsis: In an America partitioned between Nazi Germany and Imperial Japan after WWII, characters consult the I Ching while rumors spread of a banned book depicting Allied victory.

title: Stranger in a Strange Land
synopsis: A human raised by Martians arrives on Earth with psychic abilities, founding a church that preaches free love, Martian telepathy, and mutual comprehension ("grokking").

title: A Canticle for Leibowitz
synopsis: Over a thousand years across a post-nuclear dark age, Renaissance, and atomic resurgence, monks preserve the fragments of human scientific civilization.

title: The Demolished Man
